accent_family._comment: Direction A, Register (plan 094 revision 2, ledger 7753). Template/rule, not expanded values. Hue (h) comes from each app's accent_hue. Deltas apply to the accent l/c above. selected = the selected-row fill: l as given, c = accent c * c_factor, at the accent hue. ink (plan 125, spec R25) = the one dark block per page, dark in both themes, every part {l, c} at the accent hue: fill, text, muted, rule, action (a button on ink) and on_action (its label). The tinted section field is soft. An app with accent2_hue gets three quieter tone tokens at that hue (accent2, lane k12): accent2-field at the soft l, c = min(c_max, c_factor * the primary soft c); accent2-highlight at the selected l, c = min(c_max, c_factor * the primary selected c); accent2-mark at the dataviz.series_color l, c = min(c_max, c_factor * the primary accent c). Then c drops at fixed l and h until the colour is inside sRGB.

dataviz._comment: One-hue ramp (direction A, SLOP-COLOR-07): all six series use the app's accent hue, six lightness steps. Identity comes from the dash pattern in stroke_patterns (dash lengths in px, series i uses pattern i), not from six hues. series_color is only the l/c of a formula: series extra (an app's named identity colour), never a chart series. accent_exclusion_deg is the hue-collision gate distance to the status hues.

motion._comment: Lane K2 (plan 094 revision 2, spec R3/R4). Durations in ms: fast 80 = tone steps, focus draw-in, every close; base 120 = menu and popover open, tab underline slide; slow 200 = theme cross-fade, dialog and toast enter. Motion durations stay in 80 to 200 (check_tokens.py enforces it). draw 240 = a series first-draw, live 1200 = one turn of the header activity line, the only loop. ease_standard is an ease-out. ease_loop is the loop easing. Offsets in px: offset_press = the pressed-button downward translate, offset_enter = the toast start distance from its edge, offset_focus = how far outside its resting offset the focus ring starts before it draws in. scale_enter = the start scale of a menu, popover and dialog (a number, not px). scale_mark = the start scale of a mark that appears inside a control, growing from the centre of the control itself (the radio dot; lane K4, spec R9). tooltip_delay = ms a hover or focus waits before a tooltip opens (a delay, not a motion, so outside the 80 to 200 range; lane K5). ink_hold = ms that fresh ink (the accent soft tone on a changed cell) stays before it fades back over slow (a delay, not a motion, kept in 200 to 2000; lane K6, spec R18). ink_cap_per_second = a whole count, not a time: above this many ink changes per second in one view no cell gets ink and the footer says what changed (lane K6, spec R18). Plan 125 (spec R32): after one user action the motion follows cause then effect: at most sequence_moves (a count) related moves, sequence_step ms apart (40 to 60), all inside sequence_max ms (at most 320). A total draws its double rule over base; an image carries to its detail view over slow. Never a hover lift or a bounce (catalog SLOP-MOTION-02, -03).

shadow._comment: Kaliber has no shadow: --shadow-raise is none. This is only the colour an app's overrides.shadow_raise layers use (alpha comes from each layer).
